sections.Profile:
"Puddin' Head" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. on October 5, 1948.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme
